SIZE & COMPRESSION OVERRIDE (highest priority, fixes previous attempts that rendered the Pyramid far too big): copy the child-to-cushion relationship of pose reference #2 EXACTLY - the Pyramid is a COMPACT soft cushion (66 cm tall upright, 75 x 75 cm base). The 120 cm girl sits ON the lower front slope / base of the upright Pyramid (not far in front of it), her bottom sinking into the squashed front, so the apex rises only a LITTLE above the top of her head and the base is only a bit wider than her body - it must NOT tower over her or spread wide. As in #2 and compression reference #7, the soft bead-filled cushion squashes where she sits: faces bulge outward in smooth rounded curves, edges are soft and rounded, apex softly rounded - no sharp geometric pyramid.

Photorealistic e-commerce lifestyle thumbnail, square 1:1, 2048px.

REFERENCES: #1 = the product EMPTY (SHAPE reference - the cushion must look exactly like this, only recoloured). #2 = pose reference with a model (POSE/ANGLE BASE only - ignore its room/background, its colour and its person). #3 = Child KA (girl 6-7) face reference. #4 = Child KA (girl 6-7) expression sheet (8 panels: 1 neutral, 2 soft smile, 3 bright smile, 4 surprised, 5 sad, 6 frown, 7 serious, 8 side-glance smile). #5 = outfit reference KID_A_01. #6 = colour swatch. #7 = COMPRESSION reference (child sitting on the same Pyramid - copy its soft squashed roundness and modest size; ignore its colour and person).

TASK: Place Child KA with the pastel blue Yogibo Pyramid floor cushion of shape reference #1, in the exact pose, cushion orientation and camera angle of #2, in a clean studio.

PRODUCT - Yogibo Pyramid (pastel blue): a TRIANGULAR (tetrahedral) SOFT bead-filled FLOOR CUSHION - three sloped triangular faces meeting at a soft rounded apex, a flat triangular base; soft rounded edges, a smooth stretch cover, it dents and bulges softly where the person leans on it. Silhouette and orientation exactly as #1/#2 (standing upright, apex up). STRICTLY NO chair shape, NO round bean bag, NO armrests, NO piping, NO zipper, NO visible brand tag, NO square cube.
EXACT SIZE: 66 cm tall (upright) x 75 x 75 cm base, 2.2 kg. ABSOLUTE SIZE RULE - VERY IMPORTANT: the Pyramid is a fixed-size object (66 cm tall upright, 75 x 75 cm base); it does NOT shrink for a child. For child KA (120 cm) sitting on the floor in front of it, the apex rises clearly ABOVE her head and the base is much wider than her shoulders - she looks small in front of it.
COLOR: pastel blue #BEDDEF - see colour swatch #6: the exact same soft pastel sky-blue over the whole cover, never shifting toward aqua, mint, navy, grey or lavender. FABRIC: soft matte stretch cotton-spandex cover.

POSE LOCK (from #2 - pose, cushion orientation and camera only): the Pyramid stands UPRIGHT on the floor (apex pointing up) behind the child; the child sits on the floor in front of it leaning back against its sloped face, legs straight out toward the camera, a small plain plush animal toy held between the knees with both hands; seen almost frontally at eye level; head toward the camera with a cheerful natural smile.

PERSON - IDENTITY LOCK (Child KA (girl 6-7) - face reference #3 and expression sheet #4, panel 3 'bright smile'): European girl aged 6-7, about 120 cm tall, round cheerful face, big bright smile; a small young child (NOT a pre-teen, NOT an adult). HAIR: light-brown hair in two braided pigtails (the braids start behind the ears and hang forward over the shoulders), a small blue hair clip on one side of the head, soft wispy baby hairs; no other hairstyle. The face must be IDENTICAL to #3/#4 in every detail - same face shape, eyes, nose, mouth, skin, freckles, age and gender; do not beautify, age, or restyle. Expression: bright happy natural smile.

OUTFIT (reference #5 - KID_A_01): light-grey short-sleeve T-shirt with a small pastel palm-tree beach graphic on the chest + cream cotton shorts. White ankle socks, no shoes. No accessories, no logos other than the print described.

SCENE / LIGHT: clean studio, seamless background and floor in very light grey #f2f2f4 (NOT pure white; no room, no coloured wall, no carpet, no furniture, no window, no plants), soft diffused daylight from the front-left, natural soft contact shadow under the cushion and the person, no props except the small plain plush toy, no text, no watermark, no logo.

CAMERA: 50 mm look, same near-frontal view and eye level as the pose reference, the whole cushion and the person fully in frame with comfortable margin, centered, square crop.
